extractions.description: The paper focuses on improving the resilience of NLP systems to adversarial attacks by introducing LAROUSSE, a new unsupervised framework for detecting textual adversarial attacks, and STAKEOUT, a benchmark for evaluating such frameworks.

primary_category.justification: The paper primarily deals with security and robustness of NLP systems against adversarial attacks, which does not directly fit into any of the predefined eco-responsible categories focusing on climate, natural systems, pollution, finance, or global south support.
primary_category.quote: Our work focuses on responsive NLP and aims at contributing to the protection of NLP systems.

secondary_categories.justification: The focus on NLP security against adversarial threats, as opposed to climate or environmental impact, makes it irrelevant to the secondary categories as well.
secondary_categories.quote: Overall, we believe this paper offers promising research direction toward safe and robust NLP systems...

primary_sub_category.justification: The research primarily revolves around AI safety and security, which does not align with the eco-responsible sub-categories centered around energy, agriculture, pollution, etc.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: As the study focuses solely on textual attack detection in NLP, it doesn't provide insights into any eco-responsible sub-category.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: ...the crucial problem of defending against malicious attacks has only drawn the attention in the NLP community.
